title: [AUG-173] Research: split Online text correction (Groq) into live line correction and live action items toggles
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 5): the "Online text correction (Groq)" setting turns on two things at once — real-time correction of transcript lines and collection of live action items. Real case: he wants corrections but not action items. Vlad noted existing toggles may already partly cover this, untested. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Actual current behavior verified: which settings/prefs gate live correction, live action items, the AUG-168 local fallback and batch corrections (file:line refs, AUG-164/AUG-168).
- [ ] Answer recorded: is a split already possible today (yes/no, how).
- [ ] Proposed settings layout (labels, defaults, consent handling, migration of existing prefs) with at least 2 options and a recommendation.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-173/transcription-settings.html (opens in a browser, no build) showing the Settings → Transcription section for each option with clickable checkboxes, dependent/disabled states and the consent notice; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] The user picks an option on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board (or, if already covered, a task to fix labels/docs); its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. Keep Groq consent rules intact. Roadmap: M1 Quick fixes. Order: 4/10.

## Findings (2026-11-04)
**Current gating (verified in code):**
- One gate: `groqTextState()` @server/src/services/groqText.ts:97-118 → `enabled = groqTextEnabled && consent fingerprint == sha256(GROQ_API_KEY)`; `isGroqTextActive()` :116.
- Live: @server/src/services/liveTranscription.ts:172-200 reads `isGroqTextActive()` once per connection; `true` starts BOTH `LiveTextCorrector` (:193, live line correction, AUG-164) AND `maybeStartExtractor` (:178-181, live action items, AUG-165); the `action-items` frame `enabled` flag (:177) = same value.
- AUG-168 local fallback lives inside `LiveActionItemsExtractor` (@server/src/services/liveActionItems.ts:1, 804-852) → exists only when the extractor runs, i.e. only with Groq consent. Local model alone gives no live items and no live corrections.
- Batch corrections: `resolveCorrectionEngine()` @server/src/services/semanticCheck.ts:50-55 — local needs `llmCorrections` + ready model; Groq needs the same consent; both → `batchCorrectionEngine`.
- UI: one toggle + one hint @client/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx:717-755 (hint :735 names both features); consent text @client/src/components/GroqTextConsentModal.tsx:28-33 covers both; panel hint @client/src/components/ActionItemsPanel.tsx:168-170; client flag via @client/src/components/FileUpload.tsx:332.

**Is a split possible today? NO.** No pref or combination turns live correction on and live action items off (or the reverse). `llmCorrections` / `batchCorrectionEngine` affect only post-recording fixes.

## Options (mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-173/transcription-settings.html)
- A — one Groq master toggle (owns consent) + child checkboxes "Fix live lines" / "Collect live action items"; prefs groqLiveCorrection / groqLiveActionItems default true → no behavior change for existing users. Smallest.
- B — feature-first: three Groq checkboxes (live fixes, live items, after-recording fixes) with one shared consent + Revoke line; migration groqTextEnabled=true → all on.
- C — Groq toggle for text fixes + "Live action items" engine dropdown Off / Groq (local fallback) / Local model only; local-only extraction is new server work.

## Decision (2026-11-04)
User picked **Option A** (AskUserQuestion). Implementation task: **AUG-190-ngh6mm**. Roadmap line updated in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-04)
**Что сделано:**
- Проверено по коду: live-коррекция и live action items запускаются одним гейтом Groq-согласия; разделить их сейчас нельзя.
- AUG-168 local fallback тоже живёт только при Groq-согласии.
- Мокап с 3 вариантами (A/B/C), кликабельные состояния и окно согласия.
- Выбран вариант A; создана задача реализации AUG-190.
**Как:** A — минимальная правка: мастер-тумблер остаётся владельцем согласия, два дочерних чекбокса с дефолтом true → без миграции и без смены поведения у текущих пользователей. B отвергнут (больше UI, отдельный Revoke), C — отвергнут (новый серверный путь local-only извлечения).
**Файлы:** @docs/mockups/AUG-173/transcription-settings.html, @project-context/roadmap/README.md, @project-context/transcription/live-transcription/README.md.
**PR / коммиты:** master 98cad7e (без PR, прямо в master).
**Грабли:** сессия оборвалась BSOD на Step 4 — находки теперь пишутся в карточку сразу после исследования. Мокап не открывался в браузере (только node --check скрипта).
**Хвосты:** реализация — AUG-190; строка в live-transcription README описывает целевое поведение до влития AUG-190.
